extraction.name: Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series with Convolutional Temporal Attention Networks
extraction.description: A novel spatio-temporal encoder combining multi-scale spatial convolutions and a temporal self-attention mechanism for panoptic segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series (SITS).
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is composed of 2433 square 128×128 patches with 10 spectral bands and at 10m resolution, obtained from the open-access Sentinel-2 platform.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some patches are still partially or completely obstructed by cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset spans over 4000 km2, with images taken from four different regions of France with diverse climates and crop distributions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The time between acquisitions is uneven with a median of 5 days. The acquisitions were taken between September 2018 and November 2019.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Each pixel of PASTIS is associated with a semantic label taken from a nomenclature of 18 crop types plus a background class.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each non-background pixel also has a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index. In total, 124422 parcels are individualized, each with their bounding box, pixel-precise mask, and crop type.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The precision and availability of Earth observations have continuously improved thanks to sustained advances in space-based remote sensing.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The task remains difficult, in particular, the combination of ambiguous borders and hard-to-classify parcel content makes for a challenging panoptic segmentation problem.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from time series of satellite images.
